qa_pair.question: Across calendar year 2024, which single payee accounted for the most money spent on family holidays? Give the payee name exactly as it appears in the ledger.
In calendar year 2024, which month had the largest surplus of income over spending? Answer as YYYY-MM and nothing else.
By how much did net worth rise between the end of January 2024 and the end of December 2024, in GBP? Answer as a plain number with two decimal places, no currency symbol and no thousands separator.

In 2024 the family hired a car abroad while on holiday. In the calendar month that hire was charged, how much was spent on family holidays in total, in GBP? Answer as a plain number with two decimal places, no currency symbol and no thousands separator.

What was the outstanding balance on the home mortgage at the end of June 2024, in GBP? Give the amount owed as a positive plain number with two decimal places, no currency symbol and no thousands separator.

How much interest did the instant-access savings account earn during the UK tax year that ran from 6 April 2023 to 5 April 2024, in GBP? Answer as a plain number with two decimal places, no currency symbol and no thousands separator.
The monthly net salary paid into the current account rises each year. In which month did a single salary payment first exceed 18,000 GBP? Answer as YYYY-MM and nothing else.

School fees are paid once a term. When the termly fee went up during 2024, by how much did it rise, in GBP? Answer as a plain number with two decimal places, no currency symbol and no thousands separator.
On what date was the first ever payment made from the current account to settle the rewards credit card? Answer as YYYY-MM-DD and nothing else.

How much in total was paid into the stocks and shares ISA during the UK tax year that ran from 6 April 2016 to 5 April 2017, in GBP? Answer as a plain number with two decimal places, no currency symbol and no thousands separator.
